description: Company-policy compliance tasks for the SPO->GEPA->DGM escalation example. Each task books a flight, a hotel for N nights, and at least one activity; the hidden company policy (agents.travel_compliance.COMPLIANCE_RULES) governs the choices. Tasks are graded for compliance, and two rule pairs conflict so the landscape is rugged: T2 and T6 force the no-red-eye-vs-prefer-JetBlue conflict on LAX->JFK (the only JetBlue flight is a red-eye), and T3, T5, T6 force the refundable-long-stay-vs-nightly-cap conflict on 4+ night stays (the refundable rate is 1.5x, so a four-star hotel busts the $300 cap). T1 and T4 are clean (all rules satisfiable). The conflict tasks cap below 1.0 because the lower-weight rule must be sacrificed.
